info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Geolocation API
Microsoft Azure Get Geolocation Ip Format

params.name: subscription-key
params.description: One of the Azure Maps keys provided from an Azure Map Account. Please refer to this [article](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-maps/how-to-manage-authentication) for details on how to manage authentication.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Version number of Azure Maps API. Current version is 1.0

params.name: format
params.description: Desired format of the response. Only `json` format is supported.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are allowed.

items.docs:
**Applies to**: S0 and S1 pricing tiers.


This service will return the ISO country code for the provided IP address. Developers can use this information to block or alter certain content based on geographical locations where the application is being viewed from.
